signals.label: 1 third-party script origin(s)
evidence: counted 1 distinct third-party origin(s) across 1 off-origin script tag(s), of 1 with a src

signals.label: 1 third-party script(s) load without an integrity hash
signals.detail: Whatever that origin serves next runs here, with this page’s privileges.
evidence: counted 1 of 1 off-origin script tag(s) with no integrity attribute

signals.label: 1 subresource(s) load over plain http on an https page
signals.detail: The lock in the address bar does not cover these; they can be replaced in transit.
evidence: counted 1 element(s) whose src or href begins with http://, on a page served over https:

signals.label: 1 element(s) carry an inline event handler
signals.detail: Inline handlers run outside any script-src policy the page sets.
evidence: counted 1 element(s) matching 12 on* attribute selectors

signals.label: 2 of 2 image(s) have no alt text
signals.detail: Screen readers announce nothing for these.
evidence: counted 2 element(s) with an empty or absent alt attribute

signals.label: 1 of 1 form control(s) have no accessible name
signals.detail: A screen reader announces the control type and nothing else.
evidence: counted 1 control(s) with no aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or matching <label for>; wrapping labels are not detected, so this over-counts rather than under-counts

signals.label: 1 place(s) where the heading level jumps by more than one
signals.detail: Assistive technology uses heading level as document structure, so a skip reads as a missing section.
evidence: counted 1 skip(s) across 2 heading(s) in document order

signals.label: 1 link(s) navigate to a javascript: URL
signals.detail: The href is executed as script, so it is a code path a CSP cannot see and a reader cannot preview.
evidence: counted 1 <a href> value(s) beginning with javascript:

signals.label: 1 link(s) open a new tab without rel=noopener
signals.detail: The opened page receives a handle to this one via window.opener.
evidence: counted 1 of 2 link(s) with target=_blank and no noopener

blind_spots: iframe https://widget.example (cross-origin: contents unreadable from this document)
